name: 20876 · Germantown, MD
findings: ZIP 20876 (Germantown) has 100 nonprofit organizations. 40 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 37 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 20876 (Germantown) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 20876 (Germantown) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).
